# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Jul 19, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on July 19 focused on stabilizing the AI agent framework through critical CI infrastructure improvements, native platform integrations, and cloud-side performance optimizations. Key efforts included resolving packaged desktop regressions, enhancing voice session reliability, and hardening cloud inference and snapshot hydration processes.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**CI and Infrastructure Hardening**
*   Integrated circular-bootstrap blockers into the CI pipeline to ensure stable build environments ([#16657](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16657)).
*   Migrated native typechecks to stable TypeScript 7, improving supportability and maintaining performance parity ([#16655](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16655)).

**Voice and Cloud Performance**
*   Optimized cloud inference by isolating chat inference workers from the monolithic bootstrap process ([#16643](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16643)).
*   Implemented bounded snapshot hydration to prevent memory exhaustion in production provisioning workers ([#16647](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16647)).
*   Improved voice session reliability by routing local TTS through agent IPC and refining buffer-delay caps ([#16652](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16652), [#16671](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16671)).

**UI and Native Integration**
*   Enhanced mobile/desktop chat overlays with native wallpaper hosting and improved glass-effect rendering ([#16656](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16656)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   **Auth & Cloud:** [#16673](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16673) (token purging), [#16669](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16669) (Redis store forwarding).
*   **Voice & UI:** [#16672](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16672) (thinking-state fix), [#16671](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16671) (Cartesia buffer cap), [#16668](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16668) (batch engine release).
*   **Registry & App:** [#16670](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16670) (plugin update), [#16656](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16656) (native wallpaper).

## CLOSED ISSUES
*   **Desktop & Orchestrator Stability:** Resolved packaged launcher/settings mounts ([#16644](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16644)), native notification boundaries ([#16645](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16645)), and orchestrator suite failures ([#16658](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16658)).
*   **Cloud & Liveness:** Addressed PGlite terminal closure recovery ([#16650](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16650)) and conversation turn isolation ([#16658](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16658)).

## NEW ISSUES
*   **Auth & Voice Gaps:** [#16666](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16666) (PWA token invalidation), [#16661](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16661) (continuous-mode auto-start fallback), [#16662](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16662) (empty-final turn stranding).
*   **System Integrity:** [#16663](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16663) (revocation poll efficiency), [#16664](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16664) (ACP readiness), [#16665](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16665) (cold-open send path).

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   **[#13681](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13681) Nightly App Live E2E:** Continues to show failures in the desktop-packaged lane. Recent comments confirm that while specific legs (like screenshot capture and settings-shell timeouts) have been addressed, the overall scheduled cadence remains red, requiring further observation of consecutive green runs.
*   **[#13889](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13889) Packaged Desktop (Linux):** Progress is being made on first-run and pairing boundaries. Recent updates indicate that specific test seams for runtime choice and pairing are passing, though the broader packaged golden path requires ongoing validation.
